design_philosophy: Professional fintech CRM aesthetic focusing on data clarity, role-based hierarchy, and trust. Uses high-density layouts for data grids, strict structural grids, and distinct pipeline status indicators. Avoids generic SaaS look by implementing 'The Swiss Grid' for structural alignment and crisp, optical clarity.

headings.usage: Headers, large metric numbers, and auth pages.

body.usage: Data tables, forms, and general body text for maximum legibility in dense views.

brand_dark.description: Used for sidebar and deep navy accents.

dashboard.sidebar: w-64 fixed h-screen bg-brand_dark text-white border-r border-slate-800
dashboard.header: h-16 border-b border-border bg-card px-8 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-50
dashboard.density: High density grid. Use gap-4 or gap-6 for metric cards, gap-8 between major sections.

bento_grid.metrics_row: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8
bento_grid.table_span: col-span-1 lg:col-span-2 or col-span-full for wide views

cards.style: Flat Solid. bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]. No soft gradients.

tables.style: High-density. py-2.5 px-3 cells. border-b border-slate-100. hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors.
tables.header: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 bg-slate-50/80 border-b border-slate-200 py-3 px-3 text-left

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.outline: border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.sync: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm shadow-sm font-medium

forms.inputs: w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all bg-white text-slate-900 outline-none

status_pill.style: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

visual_enhancers.shadows: Strictly ambient and minimal. shadow-sm for cards. Avoid deep drop shadows on flat surfaces.
visual_enhancers.borders: Visible grid borders for technical feel. border-collapse on tabular data.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for sharp, consistent line weights. Standardize at 18px for body and 20px for sidebar.

motion.interactions: Fast and snappy. 150ms ease-in-out for hovers and form focuses.
motion.sync_indicator: Spinning animation (animate-spin) on the sync icon during active Google Sheet fetch.

auth_hero.description: Professional handshake in office, symbolizing growth partner onboarding and trust. Best for login/signup split screen.

marketing_family.description: Happy couple with a new home, representing successful loan consolidation and financial freedom.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Status pill text must have > 4.5:1 ratio against pill background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sync-sheet-btn', data-testid='assign-partner-dropdown').

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js/.jsx extensions, NOT .tsx. Generate standard React JS code.
Prioritize Shadcn tables and forms. The CRM is data-dense; do not add unnecessary padding to table cells.
Implement the 'Sync Now' functionality with a loading state to indicate background fetching from Google Sheets (or mock it elegantly).
Create a robust Lead Detail view with an activity timeline (Notes, Status Changes) side-by-side with lead info.
Use 'Outfit' font for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for the dense data text.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals; always use Solid White with a border to avoid text clashing.
The admin dashboard sidebar should use the 'brand_dark' color to create a clear structural anchor.
Add empty states for tables (e.g., 'No leads found. Sync with Google Sheets to import data.')
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grid-based left-aligned structured data.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react.
